steps.name: register and run typed mission
steps.command: bun services/platform/src/cli/holo.ts mission template:register .../template-test.echo.json --json; bun ... mission run test.echo --goal ... --idempotency-key s15-human-echo-20260718 --json
steps.pass: completed typed output includes compiler/registry/executor/schema/fleet/model provenance and no_cloud_fallback=true

steps.name: closed DSL and fleet fail-closed controls
steps.command: bun ... mission template:register invalid executable, unknown stage, and unknown schema fixtures --json
steps.pass: all reject with nonzero exit and no template/version/run rows

steps.name: checkpoint SIGKILL and pinned resume
steps.command: HOLO_TEST_CHECKPOINT_BARRIER=1 bun ... mission run test.sigkill ...; kill -9 after DB checkpoint_stage_index=1; bun ... mission resume <run> --json after lease expiry
steps.pass: SIGKILL exit 137, committed checkpoint survives, resume increments attempts and completes from checkpoint

steps.name: atomic commit crash boundary
steps.command: HOLO_TEST_CRASH_AT=mission-commit/after_commit_insert_before_run_update bun ... mission run test.echo ...; kill -9 after readiness marker; query rows; resume after lease expiry
steps.pass: readiness marker observed, transaction rollback has zero commit/event rows before resume, replayed completion has one terminal commit/event

steps.name: exact-once idempotent replay
steps.command: bun ... mission run test.echo with original completed idempotency key --json
steps.pass: replay=true and original run id is returned

steps.name: explicit budget termination
steps.command: bun ... mission template:register template-test.budget.json --json; bun ... mission run test.budget ... --json
steps.pass: nonzero CLI exit with status/errorCode budget_exceeded and persisted usage/budget provenance

steps.name: authenticated RN HTTP create/status/steer/verdict
steps.command: start real bun services/platform/src/index.ts; curl Bearer RN create/status/steer/verdict; curl Bearer control status; stop server
steps.evidence: s15-07-health.json, s15-07-create-rn.json, s15-07-status-rn.json, s15-07-steer-rn.json, s15-07-verdict-rn.json, s15-07-status-control.json
steps.pass: real Postgres/fleet health, RN-owned run, persisted ordered steer/verdict events, documented control alias
